name: iam:PassRole + ecs:RegisterTaskDefinition + ecs:StartTask
description: Register an ECS task definition with a privileged role and start it on an EC2 container instance to execute attacker-controlled container commands with the role's permissions
author: Seth Art

required.description: Target role ARN must be in the Resource section
Must have permission to register new task definitions
Must have permission to start tasks on an EC2 container instance

additional.description: Discover EC2 container instances in the cluster

admin: An ECS cluster must exist with at least one registered EC2 container instance
A role must exist that trusts ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com with administrative permissions
lateral: An ECS cluster must exist with at least one registered EC2 container instance
A role must exist that trusts ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com

references.title: Weaponizing AWS ECS Task Definitions to Steal Credentials From Running Containers

options.name: ROLE_ARN
options.description: Target IAM role ARN to pass to the ECS task (must trust ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com)

options.name: CLUSTER_NAME
options.description: ECS cluster name or ARN containing the EC2 container instance

options.name: CONTAINER_INSTANCE_ARN
options.description: ARN of the EC2 container instance to start the task on

options.name: CONTAINER_IMAGE
options.description: Container image to use for the task

payloads.name: backdoor/attach-policy
payloads.description: Attach AdministratorAccess policy to an IAM user or role via ECS task container command
